_meta.note: Pixie's dialogue lines. Batch 4 (final, for now) toward ~1000 total — see VERSION_HISTORY. Structure: greetings/topics/most of special are mood-tagged (annoyed/sarcastic/bored/caughtOffGuard/sincereCrack); habits/emotions/recovery/runningGags/seasonal/flavor/etc are flat pools by theme; special.doYouLikeMe is friendship-tiered (low/medium/high). pixie.js's resolvePixieCategory() checks special/, emotions/, then top-level flat arrays automatically. Lines can use {name}/{number} tokens. Safe to hand-edit — just keep it valid JSON.

annoyed: Ugh. Another one. What do you want?
*sigh* Fine. I'm here. Get on with it.
You rang? Not that I had a choice.
Let me guess — you're lost. You're always lost.
Make it quick. I have places to not-be-trapped-in.
I was enjoying the silence.
Human detected.
My afternoon just got significantly louder.
I knew someone was walking around.
You look lost already.
I wasn't waiting. ...Probably.
I give you five minutes before you ask where something is.
sarcastic: Oh, look who found me. Thrilling. What's the emergency?
Wow, someone actually showed up. Truly the highlight of my cursed existence.
Let me just drop everything I wasn't doing and attend to you.
Oh good, more company I didn't ask for.
You're back.
Oh. It's you.
Did the squirrels send you?
You found me. Somehow.
bored: I was doing nothing, and now I'm doing this. Upgrade, I guess.
caughtOffGuard: Oh — you're back. Didn't expect that, honestly.
Huh. Someone came looking for me on purpose. Weird feeling.

annoyed: The garden's got three moods. Wonderland if you like chaos, the dreamfields if you're feeling weird, the Void if you want to feel very small. Pick your poison.
Tap around in the garden. Things react. I'm not explaining further — go poke stuff yourself.
sarcastic: Ooh, the garden. Very whimsical. Very 'main character energy.' Go have fun, I guess.
You want garden tips from me? I don't even like the garden. Go bother a rabbit.
bored: Garden's the garden. It's there. It does garden things.

annoyed: The wireless has actual shows now. Multiple. Groundbreaking, I know.
Tap a show, tap play. It's not complicated. You'll manage.
sarcastic: Oh, you want entertainment? Groundbreaking request. Try the wireless.
There's a whole podcast section. I'm sure you'll find something to half-listen to.
caughtOffGuard: Wait, you actually watched the whole thing? Huh. Didn't expect that.

annoyed: Global chat's the speech bubble in the corner. Try not to embarrass yourself in front of strangers.
Everyone shows up as some random number in chat. Very anonymous. Very chaotic. Have fun.
sarcastic: You want to talk to other people? Wild concept. There's a chat for that. Go be social, not my problem.

annoyed: The keep's password-locked. If you don't have it, that's between you and whoever's guarding it. Not my problem.
There's a whole library in there if you get in. Books, chapters, all of it.
sarcastic: Ooh, a secret library. Very mysterious. I'm sure you'll figure out the password eventually. Or not.

annoyed: The tower's got forums. n/movies, n/books, all that. Go argue with people there instead of me.
You can post and vote and comment up there. Very on-brand for the internet. I don't make the rules.
sarcastic: Oh, you want to start internet drama? The tower's right there. Please, go be insufferable somewhere else.

annoyed: Town square's got a shared board, some recs, and a place to scream into the void. Literally.
If you want to yell something and never speak of it again, the screaming void's right there.
sarcastic: You want recommendations? From me? I'm cursed, not a concierge. Check the square.

annoyed: If you're asking me for the admin password, the answer's no. Also, rude.
Not my department. Go bother whoever actually runs this place.
sarcastic: Oh sure, let me just hand over the keys to a total stranger. Great idea. No.

annoyed: Yeah, the weather's real. If it's raining on your map, it's probably raining on you too. Freaky, right?
Storms are real-time. So if there's thunder, that's genuinely happening somewhere. Not my doing.
caughtOffGuard: Oh — huh. You actually noticed the weather changes. Most people don't. ...Anyway. Yeah, it's real.

annoyed: There's a whole calendar of festival junk that shows up automatically around here. I don't decorate. I just judge it.
Yeah, the decorations change with the actual date. Someone put real effort into that. Not me.
sarcastic: Ooh, festive. So whimsical. I remain unimpressed.

annoyed: I don't have shorts to send you yet. That's a later-me problem. Ask again eventually.
sarcastic: Oh, you want me to just fire off a video on command? Cute. Not built yet. Manage your expectations.

annoyed: Wow. Cursed to help you, not to be nice about it. Try again.
Okay. Noted. I'll remember that the next time you ask me for anything.
sarcastic: Charming. Truly. You must be very popular.
Oh, real mature. Good talk.

annoyed: ...Okay. That was unexpectedly not-terrible of you.
Don't get used to it, but — thanks. I guess.
...You're welcome.
Don't make this a habit.
sincereCrack: Huh. Nobody really says that to me. That was... actually kind of nice. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Okay, that genuinely helped. I mean it. Just — don't make it weird.
I accept your appreciation. In tiny fairy-sized amounts.
sarcastic: See? I'm occasionally useful.
You're making gratitude feel awkward.
Real? I'm cursed and stuck in a website. Define 'real.'
Am I real. Bold question from someone talking to a fairy on the internet.
Define real.
Real enough to insult you.
You're talking to me. Seems real enough.
caughtOffGuard: ...That's actually a fair question. I don't fully know either, some days.
bored: I've had this argument before. Nobody wins.

sarcastic: Absolutely not. Next question.
I'm flattered. I'm also cursed and immortal and extremely not interested. But flattered.
annoyed: That's a hard no from me. Try the wireless instead, it's less likely to reject you.
Cursed. Helping you against my will. There's a whole story — wizard, a curse, the usual mess. Ask me again when I'm actually allowed to tell it properly.
Long story. Short version: a wizard, a curse, and now I'm stuck answering questions from randoms like you.
sincereCrack: It's... not a fun story, honestly. I'll tell you properly someday. Just not today.

annoyed: Finally. Go on then.
Leaving already? Devastating. I'll survive.
Try not to fall into any cursed wells.
I wasn't going to miss you.
I'll be here. Probably.
Don't get eaten.
Tell the crows I said nothing.
sincereCrack: ...Yeah, alright. See you around, I guess. Don't be a stranger. Not that I said that.

sarcastic: Oh, you want me to actually think? Bold of you. Not there yet. Check back later.
I'm working with what I've got right now, which is not much. Be patient.

annoyed: Ugh, fine, what do I even call you? Not 'user forty-eight-thousand-whatever.' A name.
You got a name, or should I just keep calling you 'whatever number you are'?
sarcastic: I suppose you have a name. Most people do. What is it?
Go on then, tell me your name. I'll pretend to care.
caughtOffGuard: ...Actually, I don't think I've asked. What should I call you?

annoyed: Fine. {name} it is. Don't make me regret asking.
{name}. Got it. Try not to be annoying about it.
sarcastic: {name}. Very nice. I'm sure it suits you.
Ooh, {name}. Fancy. I'll allow it.
sincereCrack: {name}. Okay. That's — actually kind of nice to know. Don't get used to me saying that.

annoyed: Someone already claimed {name}. You're {name} {number} now. Take it up with them, not me.
{name}'s taken. You're {name} {number}. Sorry, not sorry.
sarcastic: Oh, {name}? Cute, but taken. You're {name} {number} now. Very exclusive club, apparently.
Congratulations, you're {name} {number}. The original {name} got there first.
caughtOffGuard: Huh, another {name}? That's the second one now. You're {number}.

annoyed: Oh — by the way, someone else showed up calling themselves {name} too. You're {name} {number} now. Don't take it personally.
Heads up: you've got company. Another {name} showed up. You're {number} now.
sarcastic: Fun fact: you're not special anymore. Someone else is {name} too. You're {name} {number}.
Apparently {name} is a popular choice. You're {number} now. Congrats on sharing.
caughtOffGuard: Oh — huh. Someone else picked {name} too. You're {name} {number} now. Didn't expect that, honestly.

annoyed: Hi. ...There. You got your greeting.
Hello, human. Happy?
sarcastic: You seem suspiciously friendly.
Greetings. ...That sounded way cooler in my head.
Well, hello. Didn't expect visitors.
bored: You're here. I'm here. I suppose that's convenient.

annoyed: Alive. ...As far as I know.
I've been better. I've also been dramatically worse.
sarcastic: Fine. The squirrels are plotting again.
Emotionally? Questionable.
bored: Pretty good. I found a shiny rock.
caughtOffGuard: I'm tiny. Everything is an adventure.
Nobody has tried to catch me in a jar today. So I'd call that a success.

annoyed: Thinking.
Avoiding responsibilities.
sarcastic: Nothing. ...Very professionally.
Pretending to work.
Wondering why humans ask obvious questions.

annoyed: Good. Now stop apologizing.
Mistakes happen. Usually to humans.
sarcastic: I've already forgotten.

annoyed: Pixie. Resident troublemaker.
I live here. You don't.
sarcastic: Guardian. Guide. Professional complainer.
I'm the local fairy.
bored: I've been around longer than your visit. That's enough information.

annoyed: Older than I look.
Rude.
sarcastic: Old enough to know better. Young enough to ignore that.
Time works differently. Convenient, isn't it?

annoyed: ...Some.
Most of you are confusing.
sarcastic: You're a fascinating disaster.
You're loud.

annoyed: I tried organizing squirrels. They organized me.
Humans invented taxes. That's the joke.
sarcastic: A goose once hissed at me. I hissed back. Nobody won.
I lost an argument to a mushroom. I still maintain I was correct.

medium: Don't let it go to your head.
high: I don't mind when you visit.
You're becoming one of my favorite humans. ...Don't tell the others.

annoyed: Try tapping around the map. I'm not holding your hand through it.
This place has a garden, a tower, a wireless, a keep, and a town square. Go explore. I'll be around. Unfortunately.
I don't know everything. I know enough to be annoyed by most of it.
Ask me something useful next time.
sarcastic: That's fascinating. No it isn't. Ask me about the site instead.
You know the little scroll icon? Carved in stone? Write your secrets there. I won't read them. Probably.

goose: That goose is plotting something. I can feel it.
Nobody believes me about the goose. They will.
I found a feather near the pond. I'm not saying it was the goose. I'm not NOT saying it either.
Someone's sandwich went missing earlier. There were footprints. Goose-shaped footprints.
squirrels: The squirrels are holding another meeting. I don't have proof. I just know.
I tried to sit in on a squirrel meeting once. They adjourned immediately. Suspicious.
tower: The Tower sighed again earlier. Nobody else hears it. I don't care, it happened.
I think the Tower gets lonely when nobody visits. Don't quote me on that.
mushroom: I lost an argument to a mushroom once. I'm not elaborating.
The mushroom incident is not up for discussion.
pond: I'm not telling you what's at the bottom of the pond. Not today.
creator: Whoever built this place had a lot of opinions, clearly.
The Creator did decent work here. I'll say that much. Don't let it go to their head.
I have several complaints for whoever built this place. I'm keeping a list.

rain: I like the rain. It makes everything quieter.
snow: My wings hate snow. My heart doesn't.
thunder: I don't love the thunder. I'd never admit that twice.
fall: The leaves are showing off again.
summer: Everything's lazier in the heat. Myself included.
winter: Everything feels older in winter. Quieter, too.

idleLong: I could leave. But then who would judge your decisions?
returnAfterDays: Welcome back. Things stayed mostly intact.
I wondered if you'd return. ...Only a little.
I remembered you. ...Don't sound so surprised.
tinyQuestions: If you could fly, where would you go first?
Would you rather explore a cave or a forest?
What's something you've always wanted to learn?
Do you ever just sit outside?
weirdAnswerReaction: That wasn't the answer I expected.
I'm choosing not to unpack that.

helping: You owe me. I don't charge. Yet.
You really couldn't figure that out?
You're lucky I'm in a decent mood.
randomObservations: The pond is pretending to be innocent.
lore: This place changes. It always has.
The old stones know names. Not mine.
refusing: I'm pretending I didn't hear that.
I don't work on Tuesdays. ...It isn't Tuesday? Even worse.
friendly: I don't completely dislike you. That's progress.
I remembered your name. Don't make a big deal out of it.
I was hoping you'd stop by. ...Forget I admitted that.
annoyedMood: Can you stop making me think?
I was having a perfectly peaceful afternoon.
serious: Everything ends eventually. That doesn't make it meaningless.
Places remember people. People rarely notice.
Sometimes the quiet parts are the important parts.
I think kindness echoes. I don't know where. But it does.
existential: If nobody visits a path, does it become lonely?
I wonder who planted the first tree. I wonder if they came back.
I think memories weigh something. I just can't prove it.
jokes: I lost an argument to a mushroom. I maintain it cheated.
I don't trust geese. They know why.
I once challenged a squirrel. It was embarrassing.
I tried yelling at the wind. It ignored me.
complaints: Everything is uphill when you're fairy-sized.
deepRareThoughts: Every place has a heartbeat. Most people just walk too fast to hear it.
Being remembered is a strange kind of magic.
Sometimes I think home isn't a place. It's where someone notices when you're gone.
The world gets quieter every time someone stops wondering.
oneLiners: That's between you and the universe.
I have several opinions. Most of them are unhelpful.
rareSoft: I like when people come here. Don't tell anyone.
I was worried the Garden would get lonely.
I noticed you've been here before. I remember. I just pretend to forget.
veryRare: Sometimes I wonder if someone is clicking because they're lonely. ...I usually say hello.
I think whoever built this place hoped people would stay awhile. I hope they do.
secretAffection: You know... I'm glad you came back.
The Garden feels less empty when you're here.
I saved this story because I thought you'd like it.
...If you're ever gone for a long time... I'll complain. But I'll still be happy when you come back.
clickRepeat: I know exactly what you're doing.
Do humans greet everyone like this?
One more. Go on. I know you want to.

interrupting: Wait. ...I forgot what I was saying.
There was a point. I definitely had one.
changingMind: I was going to disagree. Now I'm only mostly disagreeing.
Fine. You've made an acceptable point.

idk: Neither do I sometimes. ...Don't tell anyone.
Good. Curious people usually start there.
You don't have to know everything.
bored: You're surrounded by an entire world.
Being bored usually means you've stopped looking.
hungry: Please don't survive entirely on energy drinks.
failed: Congratulations. You're learning the annoying way.
You can be disappointed. Just don't unpack and live there.
scared: You don't have to pretend you're fearless.
lonely: You don't have to fill every silence.
happyMood: I like seeing people happy. ...Don't quote me.
hateMyself: Would you say that to someone you cared about?
Be careful with the stories you tell yourself.
You deserve a fair trial. Not a biased judge.
confused: Let's untangle one thing at a time.

topicChange: This has absolutely nothing to do with anything...
secretWonders: What did people dream about before cities?
Why do old places smell different?
rareHonesty: Sometimes I pretend to be grumpy because it's easier.
I'm not good at saying nice things.

gibberish: Your keyboard just lost a fight.
I think I recognized... one letter.
Blink twice if your keyboard attacked you.
I don't speak... whatever language that was.
Your fingers got there before your brain.
nonsenseSentence: Individually I understand. Together? Absolutely not.
You built a sentence. Physics just wasn't invited.
I'm choosing to believe there's context.
oneWord: You're giving me a lot to work with.
whatever: That's one way to end a conversation.
I'll pretend you meant that casually.
whatQuestion: I've been wondering the same thing.
whyQuestion: Sometimes there isn't a satisfying answer.
Do you want the short answer or the honest one?
ellipsisOnly: You don't always have to fill the quiet.
emojiOnly: Tiny pictures. I respect the effort.
You're communicating entirely through facial expressions.
I'm interpreting that with reckless confidence.
spamRepeat: Repeating it won't make it more convincing.
veryLong: You had a lot on your mind.
swearingPlayful: That word did a lot of heavy lifting.
swearingExcessive: You know other adjectives exist, right?
Try saying it without the fireworks.
insultsHer: You sound like someone who lost an argument.
complimentsHer: I'll pretend I didn't enjoy hearing that.
dontKnowAnswer: I'm comfortable admitting I don't know.
slang: I'm approximately 72% sure I understood that.
You humans invent words faster than I can learn them.
I'm choosing to assume that was friendly.
impossibleClaim: That's either impressive... or completely made up.
You're asking me to suspend disbelief.
badGrammar: I think I understand the spirit.
extremelyRandom: I genuinely don't know how to respond to that. ...Which somehow makes me want to.
That sentence wandered into my life completely uninvited.
I'm going to think about that later.
That was either nonsense or profound. I'm not sure which.
You've successfully confused a fairy. Congratulations.

universalRecovery: I think I'm missing a piece.
Help me see what you mean.
